While the study also performs genetic perturbations (ITGA3-KO) and chemical modulations (PMA, GÖ6976), the mass spectrometry proteomics data (PXD017913) specifically focuses on the composition of integrin adhesion complexes (IACs) formed on different BM ligands. Therefore, the ligand stimulation is the primary variable for the MS dataset.
